methods_quotes.q: Statistical comparisons were made using t-tests on weighted data to account for the complex survey design.
Differences were considered statistically significant at p<0.05.
Sampling weights were adjusted for dual-frame (landline and cellular telephone), nonresponse, noncoverage, and overlapping samples of mixed telephone users.
Estimates with 95% CI half-widths >10 might not be reliable.
